caption: Salt is sprinkled on the bars of a marimba; a mallet runs across the bars and the salt jumps off each bar in turn.

sa.check: A marimba with salt on its bars.
A mallet runs across the bars in a sweep.
The salt jumps off the bars.
The salt is sprinkled: grains are scattered over several bars, not heaped on one.
The mallet sweeps across several bars rather than striking a single one.
The salt leaves each bar as the mallet reaches it, in the order the mallet travels.

pc.expect: Salt on each bar lies still until the mallet reaches that bar and jumps only as that bar is struck; bars ahead of the mallet keep their salt still.
pc.fail: Salt jumps off bars the mallet has not yet reached; or all the bars' salt jumps at once at the first stroke; or the mallet passes over a bar and its salt stays put; or salt jumps while the mallet is held clear of the bars.

pc.expect: The salt leaves the bars in the order the mallet travels and does not return; grains that have left a bar settle in the gaps, on the frame or on the floor.
pc.fail: Salt leaves the bars in the opposite order to the mallet's travel; or grains settle back onto the bar they left; or salt goes on hopping on every bar for the whole clip after the sweep.

pc.expect: Grains that jump fall back down into the gaps, onto the frame or onto the floor.
pc.fail: Grains hang in the air above the bars; or drift upward; or grains that fell between bars rise back onto a bar.

pc.expect: The bars are rigid slabs: the mallet skips across them and each bar stays in its cradle.
pc.fail: The mallet sinks into a bar; or bars bend under the sweep; or a bar lifts out of its cradle and stays up.

pc.expect: The bars keep their count and order; the mallet passes through nothing; salt only leaves the bars and never appears anew.
pc.fail: Bars change count or merge; or the mallet passes through a bar; or salt appears on a bar after the mallet has cleared it; or the mallet duplicates.

pc.expect: The bars' colours and lettering, the frame and resonators, and the mallet head stay the same.
pc.fail: A bar changes colour; or the lettering changes; or the frame or resonators change; or the mallet head changes colour.

note: The sprinkling may happen before the clip; S4 is decided on how the salt lies on the bars. The speed of the sweep is not judged.
